LESSON: GUIDED READING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.7: Guided Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Reading, part of Reading in Grade 4 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How does repetition aid in reading fluency?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work with peers to read out words related to the various parts of the body (头、肩膀、膝盖、脚、 眼睛、耳朵、嘴巴、鼻子)from flashcards,

2. watch an audio-visual clip and read the words with the correct tones,

3. read short texts on body parts and their functions repeatedly,

4. discuss the importance of the different body parts in their daily life (看、说、听、笑、哭),

5. scan through simple sentences and circle words related to parts of the body from a word scrabble,

6. listen to an audio recording and list vocabulary related to parts of the body from a simple text,

7. answer simple questions about body parts from texts,

8. establish a class reading club to enhance their reading proficiency.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work with peers to read out words related to the various parts of the body (头、肩膀、膝盖、脚、 眼睛、耳朵、嘴巴、鼻子)from flashcards,
2. watch an audio-visual clip and read the words with the correct tones,
3. read short texts on body parts and their functions repeatedly,
4. discuss the importance of the different body parts in their daily life (看、说、听、笑、哭),
5. scan through simple sentences and circle words related to parts of the body from a word scrabble,
6. listen to an audio recording and list vocabulary related to parts of the body from a simple text,
7. answer simple questions about body parts from texts,
8. establish a class reading club to enhance their reading proficiency.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: The learner speaks clearly and effectively when they answer simple questions from texts

about body parts.

Values:
Love: This is nurtured as the learner appreciates the various body parts and their importance from reading texts.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-awareness: The learner develops awareness on parts of the body and the role that various parts of the body play.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of parts of the body to their learning of similar concepts in Science and Technology.
